cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You can borrow the dress for ten pounds and an acknowledgment that you mocked it. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Money covers fabric. It doesn't cover wearing my bad taste proudly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now say which part of my judgement improved since yesterday.
